query:
SELECT 
  cpr.id,
  cpr.segment,
  cpr.city,
  cpr.status,
  cpr.tenantId,
  m.tenantId as adminTenantId
FROM commercialPointRequests cpr
LEFT JOIN users u ON cpr.userId = u.id
LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId
WHERE u.role IN ('admin_bp', 'analyst_bp');
